description: HRS Systems | https://hrssystems.com | Remote (US) | Full-Time | SWE HRS Systems builds engineering software for the fire protection industry. We are continuing at a rapid pace to build features after the successful launch of our revamped product HASSCloud, with future development centered around web-based CAD solutions. We are a small team shipping software rapidly and expanding the development team. The ability and experience to take features from an idea to a polished and shipped function is essential. If this opportunity excites you, email awp@hrssystems.com with your resume.
